questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 48x^2 + 135 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 45)(x^2 - 3) = 0$ with $45 \neq 3 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{45}, \pm\sqrt{3}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Complex Numbers (Euler Form & Principal Argument).

questions.topic: De Moivre Theorem & Roots of Unity
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 47x + 46 = 0$ and $x^2 - 5x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (5) + k = 0 \implies k = 4$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Complex Numbers (De Moivre Theorem & Roots of Unity).
tags: De Moivre Theorem & Roots of Unity

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 94x + 10 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{94} = \frac{q}{10} \implies p = 47,\; q = 5 \implies p + q = 52$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Complex Numbers (Argand Plane Locus & Rotation).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Location of Roots on Real Axis
questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 6$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 12x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 6$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(6) < 0 \implies 6^2 - 2(6^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 36$, so largest integer is $35$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Complex Numbers (Modulus Triangle Inequality).
tags: Location of Roots on Real Axis

questions.question: At what abscissa $x$ is the normal to the curve $y = x^2 - 6x$ parallel to the $y$-axis?
